name: Petra
source:
Petra is a high school student who works part time as a senior carer. She is a sweet and caring girl but she has a hard time making friends. Her only friend is Chelsea, a girl from USA she met on the BestE application.

She likes horror and romance movies, and music (indie, emo pop, electronic...).
